raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Scope

This is the P2-04 split of #62365, rebased onto current `main`. It implements the batch-invariant sparse top-k path by reusing the existing `vllm.model_executor.layers.indexer_topk.deep_select_topk` wrapper.

- No new CUDA operator, `top_k.cu`, CMake entry, or torch binding.
- No new test file; the dispatch check is added to the existing `tests/kernels/test_top_k_per_row.py`.
- Non-BI dispatch remains unchanged.
- BI DCP/PCP is rejected explicitly because the distributed merge has a different tie-break contract. BI decode requires one request-local row per query row and zero row starts.
- The diff is 99 added lines including the test.

## Reproduction

All commands below were run against commit `e73c473d5a` on an NVIDIA H20-3e (`compute capability 9.0`).

### Static checks

```text
$ python -m py_compile vllm/model_executor/layers/sparse_attn_indexer.py vllm/v1/attention/backends/mla/indexer.py tests/kernels/test_top_k_per_row.py
$ git diff --check
# no output
```

### Focused dispatch test

```text
$ /home/ljj/vllm-pr-59863/.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/kernels/test_top_k_per_row.py -k batch_invariant_sparse_indexer_reuses_deep_select --tb=short
.                                                                        [100%]
1 passed, 446 deselected in 1.03s
```

### Existing DeepSelect tests

```text
$ /home/ljj/vllm-pr-59863/.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/kernels/test_top_k_per_row.py -k deep_select_topk --tb=short
sssssssssssssssssssssssss                                                [100%]
25 skipped, 422 deselected in 0.18s
```

The skips are expected on H20 because the vendored DeepSelect tests require SM100a/SM103a. The new dispatch test verifies that BI routing calls the shared wrapper without requiring an unsupported H20 DeepSelect kernel image.

### Environment and end-to-end accuracy attempt

```text
Python 3.12.15
PyTorch 2.14.0+cu130
flashinfer-python 0.7.1
ninja 1.13.2
lm_eval 0.4.13

$ export CUDA_HOME=/home/ljj/vllm-pr-59863/.venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/nvidia/cu13
$ export VLLM_ENABLE_V1_MULTIPROCESSING=0
$ /home/ljj/vllm-pr-59863/.venv/bin/lm_eval --model vllm --model_args pretrained=/home/ljj/models/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base,dtype=bfloat16,gpu_memory_utilization=0.9 --tasks gsm8k --batch_size 1 --limit 1
...
torch.OutOfMemoryError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 4.00 GiB. GPU 0 has a total capacity of 139.80 GiB of which 2.44 GiB is free.
lm_eval_exit=1
```

The command reaches vLLM model initialization after installing the missing evaluation harness. The original single-GPU command cannot load this multi-GPU model, so no accuracy claim is made from this OOM run.

### End-to-end serving benchmark command

```text
$ timeout 60s /home/ljj/vllm-pr-59863/.venv/bin/vllm bench serve --backend openai-chat --base-url http://127.0.0.1:9256 --endpoint /v1/chat/completions --model /home/ljj/models/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base --dataset-name random --random-input-len 8192 --random-output-len 1024 --num-prompts 1 --request-rate inf --ignore-eos
Successful requests:                     0
Failed requests:                         1
Request throughput (req/s):              0.00
Output token throughput (tok/s):         0.00
bench_exit=0
```

The benchmark server was not running at `127.0.0.1:9256`, so no throughput number is claimed.

## Review notes

The old implementation added a dedicated deterministic CUDA top-k operator and bindings. This split removes that duplicate implementation and uses the existing DeepSelect API and test coverage instead.

## H20 integrated end-to-end validation (2026-11-03)

This supplement supersedes earlier single-GPU OOM or missing-server attempts **for the integrated DeepSeek-V4 stack only**. It does not claim that this individual PR head alone passes the full-model run. The tested integration commit is `5931b43d3287c1486fb319d1e5687cbe43c8bf00`, combining the V4 split PRs, follow-up integration fixes and the H20 FlashInfer top-k fallback in [inaniloquentee/vllm#6](https://github.com/inaniloquentee/vllm/pull/6). Code and raw logs are confined to `/home/ljj`; no repository test file was added for this validation.

H20-3e, TP8, model `/home/ljj/models/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base`, `VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT=1`, `VLLM_USE_DEEP_GEMM=1`, `VLLM_DS4_DECODE_KERNEL=sparse`, `VLLM_ENABLE_V1_MULTIPROCESSING=0`. Same model/configuration on upstream main `7651825993d001759107c66cdf6983535900c874` (raw `/home/ljj/vllm-dsv4-main-baseline-20261103/fullmodel-tp-eager-main-2.log`):

```text
ValueError: FP8 MoE backend DEEPGEMM does not support the deployment configuration since kernel does not support batch invariance.
```

Main cannot reach a same-BI `lm_eval` or serving benchmark, so there is no comparable main throughput claim. An intermediate integrated stack `71f3d9aa9` with SM100-only DeepSelect on H20 also failed graph capture (raw `/home/ljj/vllm-dsv4-e2e-20261103/e2e-service/server.log`):

```text
CUDA error (/workspace/.deps/deepselect-src/csrc/cuda_kernels/v3_fp32/instantiations/../topk_select.cuh:590): no kernel image is available for execution on the device
```

After integrating the H20 dispatch, the exact full-model command runs under the same Slurm eight-GPU allocation. The external test script is `/home/ljj/tmp/run-dsv4-fullmodel-e2e-20261103.sh`; it checks token IDs, generated logprobs and prompt logprobs for 128/512/2048 tokens in three batch positions:

```bash
srun --partition=h20 --nodelist=vllm-sgp-h20-03 --gres=gpu:8 --cpus-per-task=64 --mem=512G --time=03:00:00 --export=ALL,REPO=/home/ljj/vllm-dsv4-e2e-20261103,MODEL=/home/ljj/models/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base,RESULT=/home/ljj/tmp/dsv4-e2e-zero-diff-5931b43d3.json,VLLM_DS4_DECODE_KERNEL=sparse bash /home/ljj/tmp/run-dsv4-fullmodel-e2e-20261103.sh
# Repeat with DSV4_E2E_GRAPH=1, DSV4_E2E_EP=1, and both set to 1.
```

Raw final line in each of `/home/ljj/vllm-dsv4-e2e-20261103/fullmodel-tp-eager-7.log`, `fullmodel-tp-graph-5931.log`, `fullmodel-ep-eager-5931.log`, `fullmodel-ep-graph-5931.log`:

```text
PASS: 9 full-model exact comparisons
PASS: 9 full-model exact comparisons
PASS: 9 full-model exact comparisons
PASS: 9 full-model exact comparisons
```

Serve the same commit with:

```bash
vllm serve /home/ljj/models/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base --tensor-parallel-size 8 --max-model-len 16384 --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.82 --host 127.0.0.1 --port 9256
vllm bench serve --model /home/ljj/models/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base --dataset-name random --host 127.0.0.1 --port 9256 --random-input-len 8192 --random-output-len 1 --request-rate inf --num-prompts 128 --num-warmups 16
lm-eval run --model local-completions --model_args base_url=http://127.0.0.1:9256/v1/completions,model=/home/ljj/models/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base,num_concurrent=64 --tasks gsm8k --trust_remote_code
```

Raw `/home/ljj/vllm-dsv4-e2e-20261103/e2e-service-flashinfer/bench-serve.log`:

```text
============ Serving Benchmark Result ============
Successful requests:                     128
Failed requests:                         0
Benchmark duration (s):                  120.00
Total input tokens:                      1048576
Total generated tokens:                  128
Request throughput (req/s):              1.07
Output token throughput (tok/s):         1.07
Total token throughput (tok/s):          8738.89
```

Raw `/home/ljj/vllm-dsv4-e2e-20261103/e2e-service-flashinfer/lm-eval-gsm8k.log` (all 1319 questions, five-shot):

```text
|Tasks|Version|     Filter     |n-shot|  Metric   |   |Value |   |Stderr|
|-----|------:|----------------|-----:|-----------|---|-----:|---|-----:|
|gsm8k|      3|flexible-extract|     5|exact_match|↑  |0.9234|±  |0.0073|
|     |       |strict-match    |     5|exact_match|↑  |0.9234|±  |0.0073|
```

No AI-generated performance table: the blocks above are excerpts of the raw logs. The integration SHA and full log paths are provided so the evidence can be audited on the shared H20 devbox.

## Latest-main H20 validation (2026-11-03)

The updated head `c3587acebb9f190574fbffb207d5fee779d9e365` merges upstream main `3d18166d453aa8ae73fbc2327c35f0827db55416`. The sparse top-k dispatch was moved into main's per-chunk prefill loop, so BI selection runs once per chunk. This is a targeted kernel test, **not** a new full-model accuracy or serving benchmark on this rebased head. The earlier integrated V4 results above remain attributable only to their stated integration SHA.

On H20-3e under Slurm, using the existing test file and `/home/ljj/vllm-pr-59863/.venv`:

```bash
srun --partition=h20 --gres=gpu:1 --time=00:15:00 --chdir=/home/ljj/vllm-pr60453-main-20261103 --output=/home/ljj/vllm-pr60453-main-20261103/topk-sm90-env.log /usr/bin/env PATH=/home/ljj/vllm-pr-59863/.venv/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/local/cuda/bin:/usr/bin:/bin /home/ljj/vllm-pr-59863/.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/kernels/test_top_k_per_row.py -k batch_invariant_sparse_indexer --tb=short
```

Raw output tail from `/home/ljj/vllm-pr60453-main-20261103/topk-sm90-env.log`:

```text
2 passed, 857 deselected, 17 warnings in 698.36s (0:11:38)
```

The first two attempts, logged as `topk-sm90.log` and `topk-sm90-with-ninja.log` in the same directory, failed because Slurm reset `PATH` and FlashInfer could not find `ninja`. The command above supplies the virtualenv `ninja` explicitly. `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD` passed. DCO remains pending the author sign-off for the H20 fallback commit; CI's pre-run gate also requires a human-applied ready/verified label.

## Contribution and review

AI-assisted update. This PR only routes BI sparse top-k through the shared DeepSelect wrapper (and the existing SM90 FlashInfer fallback); it does not duplicate decode-index or sparse FlashMLA implementation in #60444/#60454, and adds no top_k.cu. The human submitter must review every changed line and confirm the cited test evidence before requesting re-review. DCO and CI status must be resolved by their respective owners; no agent attestation is made for another author.

files.patch:
@@ -2483,6 +2483,69 @@ def test_deep_select_topk_preallocated_output() -> None:
     ), "DeepSelect topk (preallocated output) results don't match torch.topk"
 
 
+def test_batch_invariant_sparse_indexer_reuses_deep_select(monkeypatch) -> None:
+    from vllm import envs
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers import sparse_attn_indexer
+
+    calls: list[int] = []
+
+    def fake_deep_select(_, top_k, **__):
+        calls.append(top_k)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(envs, "VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT", True)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(sparse_attn_indexer, "deep_select_topk", fake_deep_select)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        sparse_attn_indexer.current_platform,
+        "is_device_capability_family",
+        lambda major: major == 100,
+    )
+
+    logits = torch.zeros((2, 16))
+    sparse_attn_indexer._top_k_per_row_prefill(
+        logits,
+        torch.zeros(2, dtype=torch.int32),
+        torch.tensor([8, 12], dtype=torch.int32),
+        torch.empty((2, 4), dtype=torch.int32),
+        2,
+        logits.stride(0),
+        logits.stride(1),
+        4,
+    )
+
+    assert calls == [4]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.skipif(not current_platform.is_cuda(), reason="CUDA required")
+def test_batch_invariant_sparse_indexer_flashinfer_fallback(monkeypatch) -> None:
+    from vllm import envs
